props: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production pixel artwork for Chronforge Echo at native960x540. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters and dark ink outlines, rich readable material details, overhead three-quarter RPG props, restrained upper-left lighting, no blur, no vector-flat surfaces, no text, people, logos or watermark. Create CRATER EMBER environment PROP ATLAS, exactly4 columns by2 rows, equal square cells, image2048x1024. Genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard. Whole objects isolated with16px clear margins per cell; ground feet near bottom. Art direction: charcoal basalt, obsidian, weathered iron, tarnished copper machinery, restrained amber-red heat in cracks. No lush green leaves, no snow, no bloom. TOP ROW in exact order:1 sculptural petrified volcanic tree of charcoal-black twisting branches with sparse ember-colored mineral leaves, basalt root foot and thin copper conduits;2 tall copper pressure chimney with iron braces, pressure wheels, tiny amber gauges, heat-scorched stone footing;3 monumental circular sun-forge, heavy broken iron ring and basalt supports, old copper bellows and pipes, orange heat deep within its hollow, crafted readable silhouette;4 rugged basalt furnace aqueduct arch with riveted iron reinforcement and a molten channel contained along its top. BOTTOM ROW:5 jagged glossy black obsidian boulders with sparse copper-red crystal seams;6 inviting compact foundry shelter of soot-dark stone, patched metal roof, deep warm door, copper exhaust and coal baskets, sturdy practical construction;7 sparse ember-red mineral grass and sharp obsidian crystals clustered on ash-dark roots;8 dramatic columnar basalt cliff terrace with a great old cooling pipe and small amber seams. Intricate but coherent detailed pixel-art material, each shape distinct, real grounded geometry, no generic rectangular platforms beneath props.
